name: client-python-fault-isolated-collection-reports
instr:
prometheus_client cannot isolate collection faults while preserving completed metrics and attributable failures from one attempt. Add opt-in continuation and fail-fast reporting through Prometheus, OpenMetrics, and Graphite. Keep existing collection and exposition behavior unchanged when reporting is not used.

A `CollectionReport` preserves completed metric families and `CollectionFailure` records in registration traversal order, including data yielded before a late exception. `CollectionPolicy` is a Enum and governs every selected collector uniformly: continuation retains later outcomes; fail-fast invokes nothing after the first failure. Collect-only custom collectors must interoperate without changing ordinary collection laziness, values, or exception boundaries.

Built-ins report failures at their genuine atomic boundaries: labelled child reads, GC acquisition, process stat and descriptor sections, platform metadata construction, and individual multiprocess files. Preserve successful names, labels, exemplars, cached-object relationships, process partials, GC acquisition behavior, and multiprocess aggregation.

Restricted reporting invokes only collectors selected by requested names, filters successful samples accordingly, and retains relevant failures. `generate_latest_report` and `generate_openmetrics_report` encode successful families with deterministic failure diagnostics in valid output. `GraphiteBridge.push_report` sends every successful sample from complete or parti
